Content is a pastoral-ethical dialogue: a disciple has reported a problem about walking on roads (treading on the Living Soul/cross of Light), and the Apostle responds with ethical teaching distinguishing journeys taken for God's matter (sinless, even if one treads on the cross of Light) from journeys taken from personal desire/property (sin). Heavy use of 'cross of Light' (ⲡⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ) and 'elect' (ⲛⲉⲕⲗⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ) — Manichaean institutional theology. The final segment may be the opening of a substrate analogy ('the Living Soul is likened to a man') but the analogy is not yet developed. Damage ratio is high (71%).
